2: (22 min) Sear the cauliflower steaks in the remaining oil and the butter in a hot ovenproof pan for 3 minutes a side, then roast at 220C for 15 minutes until tender in the middle.
3: (6 min) Wipe out the pan, cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the brandy, stock and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
4: (5 min) Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the cauliflower steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.
veg.name: Douglas Sirk cauliflower steak
